safety_assault_protection_002.evidence: Teachers will immediately report to the school principal in writing all cases of assault/battery suffered by them in connection with their employment. ... If a teacher is sued in tort ... the Board will provide for legal counsel ... damages, injuries, or material loss suffered by the teacher shall be fairly compensated for by the Board. ... said student will be expelled.

safety_student_discipline_003.evidence: Disciplinary control of students' conduct in the classroom is the teacher's responsibility. Upon referral by the teacher, extreme behavioral problems are the principal's responsibility for appropriate disciplinary actions.

safety_remove_student_004.evidence: ...the teacher may remove the student from class consistent with School Board policy and the provisions of Section 1003.32, Florida Statutes.
